title: Remote executor state is not observable from the host API: no executor-operation stage or effect, and no pendingPrompts, on a satellite session
outcome: Remote executor state is not observable from the host API: no executor-operation stage or effect, and no pendingPrompts, on a satellite session
acceptance: A supported read-only API on the satellite (or relayed to central) exposes, for a federation operation key, its executor stage, effect state and queue entry, plus the recipient session's pending prompt queue, so that a wake or prompt outcome can be diagnosed without reading SQLite or host logs
Focused tests cover the new read fields; a review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher; one READY goes to Merger2
